name: delay-repro
hypothesis: H1: the controller build counts a held observation's age from its arrival time, not from its sample_time_ns. Under the delay declaration of the parent, it predicts the same failure as CI: radar_age_ns 0 and mode 0 at observation 120 ms, where the reference has 2.
distinguishes: A one-off CI fault or a nondeterministic Run predicts a pass or a different divergence; H1 and H2 (kernel delivers the delayed radar wrongly) both predict the same failure, so this Run only reproduces the failure and serves as the regression case.
